title: Automate changelog and onboard orion-slim-8b v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Avery Chen
commits: Add orion-slim-8b v1.0 metadata YAML and model manifest entry
Add performance profiles (latency/throughput/seq dist) and quantization recommendations
Extend changelog generator to include model-registry tag parsing and perf-summary section
Add onboarding pipeline step to auto-generate release_notes and artifacts (perf JSON)
Add unit + e2e tests for onboarding flow and changelog generation
description: Motivation: Add orion-slim-8b v1.0 to the model registry with validated performance profiles and automate inclusion in the changelog/release notes. This PR adds a metadata entry and perf profiles for orion-slim-8b, updates the onboarding pipeline to emit the perf JSON artifact, and extends the changelog-generator so model registry entries with the 'auto-changelog' tag are picked up and summarized in release notes. Changes: 1) models/orion-slim-8b/v1.0/metadata.yaml - model metadata (architecture, weights_source, quantization_support, recommended_batching/seq_dist). 2) models/orion-slim-8b/v1.0/perf_profiles.json - generated from perf-canary runs: latency p50/p95, throughput on dedicated pools, memory/kvcache characteristics, quantized TFLOPS estimate, and recommended quantization profiles (int8, q4_0). 3) tools/changelog-generator - parse model-registry tags and attach perf-summary and migration notes to release notes; unit tests added. 4) infra/onboarding/pipeline.yml - new step to run perf-canary for PRs with model additions and upload perf_profiles.json as artifact. 5) docs/models/orion-slim-8b.md - short model card and guidance for selection (hosted vs dedicated) plus recommended route config. 6) CI - add validate-model-entry.sh and a small e2e test that runs the onboarding flow in CI. Testing: local unit tests for parser, CI e2e test that runs a lightweight perf-canary harness (seqlen 32/128) against a gold image, and manual verification of release note snippet generated by the changelog tool. Related work: ENG-4521 (onboarding pipeline), ENG-4580 (changelog automation), SUP-1287 (customer request for smaller low-latency models). Checklist: - [x] metadata YAML conforms to registry schema - [x] perf profiles produced by perf-canary and reviewed by SRE - [x] changelog generator updated and unit-tested - [x] onboarding pipeline step added and tested in staging - [x] docs added for product/SDK usage Rollout notes: mark model entry as alpha in the registry until 2026-01-15, allow RD to opt-in via model tags, and watch token cost/latency dashboards for first 48h post-release.
release_notes:
- Onboarded orion-slim-8b v1.0: small, low-latency variant suitable for dedicated and hosted workloads (alpha). Performance profiles included (latency p50/p95, throughput benchmarks)
- Changelog generator: model-registry entries with 'auto-changelog' tag are automatically summarized in release notes with perf profiles and migration guidance
- Onboarding pipeline: new perf-canary step uploads perf_profiles.json as artifact for audit and QA
review_comments: Maya Patel: Thanks, this looks comprehensive. Two asks: (1) add an explicit fallback recommendation for customers on older GPUs, (2) can we gate the changelog inclusion behind a Linear flag for the first rollout?
Avery Chen: Added fallback section to metadata.yaml recommending reduced batch sizes and q4_0 for older Ampere/Turing hardware; added linear flag in pipeline to gate auto-changelog (default: off).
Diego Ramirez: CI e2e flaked once on perf-canary (network timeout), reran and passed. Suggest adding a retry in infra job for transient net errors.
Avery Chen: Added a 2x retry wrapper to the perf-canary step and updated tests accordingly.
Kai Huang: LGTM pending CI green and one doc nit about model card wording.
